headphone-reference.purpose: Prepare a bounded reference-level check for the MOTU M2, Lake People G111 Mk2 and Focal Clear MG path.
safety_gates: Lake People volume at minimum before playback
Pioneer receiver muted, powered off, or at minimum before headphone-path playback
Only one analog control raised at a time
Stop immediately on unexpected loudness or output from the non-target receiver chain

voice-gain.purpose: Prepare a non-playing Rode NT1-A gain and phantom-power verification session.

receiver-reference.purpose: Prepare a bounded reference-level and routing check for the Pioneer receiver path.
safety_gates: Receiver volume at minimum before playback
Lake People volume at minimum before receiver-path playback
Stereo mode used until multichannel path is proven
Stop immediately on unexpected routing or output from the non-target headphone chain

motu-loopback.purpose: Prepare a bounded physical loopback recording for measured round-trip latency.
safety_gates: Headphones and receiver muted or lowered
Confirmed line output connected to a line input
48 V off on the loopback input
No microphone connected to the loopback input
facts_or_receipts_to_record: physical loopback cable and input/output pair in the measurement receipt

rules: pack creation never starts playback or recording
a pack is usable only at its exact clean Git revision and bound contract bytes
validation is read-only and fails on drift, tampering, symlinks, special files or unexpected files
physical observations and laboratory evidence remain separate private authorities
